data.one_liner: Provides value‑based equality for Dart objects without manual == and hashCode.
data.what_it_does: Equatable overrides == and hashCode based on a list of props, simplifying equality checks. It also offers optional toString support and works with immutable classes.
use_when: You need concise, reliable equality for data classes
You want to avoid boilerplate in models and tests
avoid_when: You require code generation for other purposes
You need mutable objects with custom equality
strengths: Works with const constructors and nullable props
weaknesses: Limited to equality; not a full data‑class solution

alternatives.name: stack_trace
